name: Berlin Post Punk!
description: Tonight's gig focuses on the FLINTA* community, reminding us that girls and femmes have always been at the front and centre of guitar-driven anthems. Curated by Pia H, the night was inspired by the green t-shirt with the slogan 'Girls invented punk, not England' worn by Kim Gordon, and features two bands: Dry Fruits (a three-piece outfit plays fast and punchy danceable tunes) and Lovegaze (Berlin-based band blending dreamy shoegaze with new wave music), both hot on the heels of sonic stardom.
